name: op-secrets
description: Paste an API key into the Claude chat and it is deleted before Claude reads it. To save one, a small window opens that Claude cannot see: you paste there and it lands in 1Password. Claude then starts with your keys loaded from the vault, one fingerprint check, and uses them without ever seeing them. Also stops Claude printing keys or reading .env files. Mac, Windows, Linux.
